fact: At the 5 May 2025 inauguration of TechPark CV in Praia, the Praia campus data centre was stated to be managed by NOSi, and the Mindelo campus to act as disaster recovery and business continuity site.
title: Parque Tecnológico de Cabo Verde: Polo da Praia é inaugurado esta segunda-feira na Praia e do Mindelo esta terça-feira
